title: Resume Score Checker for Freshers: How ATS Scoring Works & How to Get a 90+ Match
description: Understand ATS score calculations, keyword weighting, section parsing, and formatting checks to optimize your fresher resume.

image.alt: ATS Resume Scoring Matrix and Weight Breakdown

body:
When you submit your resume to an online job board, modern Applicant Tracking Systems compute a composite match score (0-100) before any human reviews it. Understanding how this score is calculated allows you to optimize your resume strategically for maximum interview conversion.

## 1. Anatomy of an ATS Score Calculation

- Keyword Frequency & Semantic Proximity (40% Weight): Presence of required skills, frameworks, and tools in context.
- Structural & Layout Readability (25% Weight): Clean section detection without parsing errors or merged text columns.
- Quantified Impact & Bullet Quality (20% Weight): Presence of numerical metrics, percentages, and strong action verbs.
- Experience & Education Fit (15% Weight): Verification of required degree level and graduation timeline.

## 2. Quick Wins to Boost Your Match Score by 20+ Points

- Add a dedicated 'Technical Skills' block with categorized keywords.
- Ensure exact terminology from the target job posting is reflected in your project descriptions.
- Remove unparseable graphical elements, tables, and multi-column layouts.

faq.q: What is the minimum score required to pass ATS filters?
faq.a: Most applicant tracking systems set a threshold of 75% to 80% to advance candidates to human review.
